signature.filter: exclude whole answers; strict >; answer-internal pairs only

method: exclude whole answers whose answer-internal adjacent-token-pair repetition ratio (1 - unique pairs / all pairs) is strictly greater than 0.5; prompts excluded from repetition assessment; filter each label independently; retain original answer order, then concatenate teacher-tokenizer answer IDs without separators; exact disjoint blocks, first token context only; no token-pair deduplication within retained blocks; incomplete tail discarded; ordinary median of block p-values (mean of the middle two for even counts)

filtering.scope: answer-internal adjacent token pairs; prompt excluded
